data.name: Repressed
data.detailed_description:
Repressed is a multiplayer PvPvE tactical extraction shooter set in Blackmoor, a contested open-world territory caught between two warring factions and something far more dangerous.

Choose your faction, prepare your loadout, and enter Blackmoor. Complete objectives, search for valuable equipment and supplies, fight rival operators and hostile AI, and make it to extraction with whatever you can carry.

Every deployment is a choice. Bring better gear and risk losing it, or enter light and rely on what you can find. Decide what is worth carrying, when a fight is worth taking, and when it is time to get out.

Blackmoor is a grounded far-future world of abandoned infrastructure, fortified settlements, corporate facilities, and places that should have stayed sealed.

ENTER BLACKMOOR

Blackmoor is a persistent conflict zone, not a collection of isolated arenas.

Travel into and out of the territory through its rail network, explore the open world, pursue objectives, search dangerous locations, and decide how far you are willing to push before making your way back to extraction.

Other players are only part of the threat. Armed forces patrol the territory, hostile AI defend valuable locations, and something else moves through the ruins.

What you bring home becomes part of your continued progression. What you lose stays behind.

CHOOSE YOUR FACTION

Fight for one of two playable factions competing for control of Blackmoor.

  • Backdoor Syndicate is a corporate-backed paramilitary force tasked with securing critical infrastructure, containing threats, and restoring control to the territory. Their operators are disciplined, well supplied, and convinced their presence in Blackmoor is necessary.

  • Horizon Collective is a resistance movement fighting against Backdoor occupation. They rely on local knowledge, scavenged equipment, fieldcraft, and unconventional tactics to reclaim the territory they believe was taken from them.

Your faction affects your objectives, relationships, equipment access, progression, and perspective on the events unfolding across Blackmoor.

Neither side has the full story.

BUILD YOUR KIT

Your equipment matters before the first shot is fired.

Weapons, ammunition, armor, rigs, backpacks, medical supplies, and mission equipment all compete for space and weight. Customize your weapons and build a loadout around the objective, the threats you expect to face, and how much you are willing to risk.

Combat is built around grounded weapons, ballistics, armor protection, and localized injuries. Damage to different parts of the body can create different problems, forcing you to manage wounds and medical supplies while the fight is still happening.

Surviving the engagement is only the first step. You still have to make it home.

WORK THE BLACK MARKET

Not everything moves through official channels.

The Drifters operate an underground market connecting players with equipment, supplies, and opportunities outside the normal faction economy.

Buy, sell, recover valuable goods, and decide whether what you find in Blackmoor is worth using, storing, or putting back into the economy.

Every piece of valuable equipment creates another decision: use it, sell it, or risk it on the next deployment.

INTERACT WITH THE WORLD

Objectives in Repressed are built around interacting with Blackmoor itself.

Search locations, recover evidence, repair equipment, activate systems, transport physical items, secure resources, and follow faction assignments across the territory.

Your objectives are not separate from the world around you. Completing them may force you into contested locations, expose you to other players, or lead you somewhere you were not prepared to go.

DISCOVER WHAT HAPPENED

The war between Backdoor and Horizon is only the conflict visible on the surface.

Something happened in Blackmoor.

Abandoned laboratories, sealed facilities, quarantine sites, and the things still moving through them suggest that the territory was never simply lost to war.

Both factions have their own version of what happened.

Neither knows the whole truth.

data.short_description: Repressed is a PvPvE tactical extraction shooter where players fight for survival in the open world of Blackmoor. Scavenge for supplies, complete objectives, and extract with whatever you can carry before Blackmoor, or something within it, claims you. Every decision counts. Every fight matters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 9700k / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
